review_kind: Independent exact SQL security, authorization and transaction review before local application
scope: Only the existing attested T0 local PostgreSQL databases postgres and gis_t1_upgrade, using the exact reviewed SQL in one guarded transaction with a new ledger INSERT for version 32. No old migration or ledger update is approved.

findings.detail: Migration requires the exact applied 031 checksum, matching local runtime instance and baseline, fixed local database and cluster, no existing version 32, and an unprivileged noninheriting native worker role.

Native authority derives from PostgREST session_user authenticator, role setting gis_native_worker, JWT role, exact local issuer and canonical UUID subject. A supplied worker_id must match this subject and is not authoritative.

All SECURITY DEFINER functions use fixed pg_catalog,gis search_path. Private functions are revoked from runtime roles. Existing public V2 entrypoints grant execute only to gis_native_worker; owner CREATE privilege is revoked at the end. No RLS weakening or direct table grant is introduced.

Private shared queue preserves states, bounded attempts, lease and retry backoff. V1 and V2 wrappers select a fixed protocol; claim/recover and mutation paths enforce edition metadata version, with edition then job then attempt lock order and post-lock clock fencing.

Native completion and transient failure require exact bounded report keys and types, artifact SHA, frozen input hash/revision, provider build, finite bounded statistics/warnings and mandatory scientific checks when actual validation is claimed. Report updates happen before terminal attempt transitions in the same transaction and only after fencing.

Initial candidate only checked nonempty raster statistics. The reviewed final SQL now compares successful raster grids, valid-pixel counts, mean/min/max to frozen synthetic expected answers with tolerance 0.00005. Polygon counts and areas are also enforced.

Deferred native integrity triggers block Native V2 success without a matching validated attempt report and matching immutable result report, including legacy-wrapper bypass. Existing applied migration files and existing data are not updated by the migration.
Readiness binds the signed native subject to real local environment markers and applied versions. The Python worker must compare these with trusted launcher expectations before mutations.

execution_conditions: Re-attest exact container ownership, cluster, both database identities and all applied checksums before applying.
Run only exact reviewed bytes in a local transaction; append version 32 and its actual file SHA256 atomically. Fail closed on old checksum drift.
Use actual GoTrue/PostgREST worker JWT for positive and negative runtime tests; SQL role simulation is not a substitute.
Verify post-migration ACL, RLS, function ownership and definitions and preserve legacy data and all old ledger values.
Complete actual lifecycle, recovery, fencing, fault and regression tests before final acceptance. Static review does not establish those results.
evidence_boundary: Static exact-source review only. Reviewer has not executed migrations, changed databases, called GEE/Cloud, or tested runtime behavior. Approval is for controlled local testing, not production readiness or final T3 acceptance.
